from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyAssets(BaseModel):
    """Total assets reported by a single company in their 10-Q filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the filing belongs to")
    total_assets_value: float | None = Field(description="The total assets numeric amount as reported in the filing")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the reported amount: 'thousands', 'millions', or 'dollars'")
    as_of_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the assets figure is as of, in YYYY-MM format")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Brief excerpt from the filing context")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_assets_list: list[CompanyAssets]
